 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.131/2024 registered at Police Station Bahadurpur, District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 344, 366, 376(2)(N), 34 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Applicant is in custody since 03.06.2024.

It is submitted that in relation to prosecutrix,
missing person report has been lodged on 06.04.2024.
She has been recovered on 05.05.2024 after a month.
In between one month, no complaint was made on behalf of the prosecutrix.
As per the story of prosecution, she was kept in a rented room for 25 days.
Neither she tried to call her parents nor call any person for releasing her.
It is also submitted that it is a case of consent.
DNA report is also negative.
Challan has been filed.

The applicant has no criminal NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:15783 2 MCRC-31406-2024 antecedent.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these grounds, learned counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State while opposing the bail application submits that there is ample evidence on record against the present applicant.
He fairly admits that DNA report is not positive against the present applicant.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, present application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Sunjay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92612862/
